placeholder.$description: Placeholder values from ADR-0006. None of them is a brand value; each stands in for an open SPEC.md §2.4 item.

neutral.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. The single neutral color placeholder, standing in for TBD-06 (the surface colors). Source: Tailwind 4.3.3 slate-400, Nuxt UI's default neutral, chosen by the owner (ADR-0006).

base.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-09. Source: Tailwind --spacing (ADR-0006).

sm.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-10. Source: Nuxt UI --ui-radius, --radius-sm (ADR-0006).

md.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-10. Source: Nuxt UI --radius-md (ADR-0006).

lg.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-10. Source: Nuxt UI --radius-lg (ADR-0006).

glow.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-12. Source: Nuxt UI UButton has no glow (ADR-0006). Untyped (ADR-0008).

scrimOpacity.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-15. Source: Nuxt UI UModal and USlideover overlay, bg-elevated/75 (ADR-0029).

overlay.$description: Placeholder, not a brand value. Stands in for TBD-15. Source: Tailwind --shadow-lg, used by UModal and USlideover (ADR-0006). Untyped (ADR-0008).
